app.open: AdeeboMeter is running. Everything is being watched.
Ready. Your PC and network are being checked.
Started. First readings in a few seconds.
Watching your network quietly in the corner.
Back on. Checking your PC, Wi-Fi and internet.
all.good: PC, Wi-Fi and internet are all fine.
pc.busy: Your PC is busy. Close something before opening more.
CPU is at {v}. One program is using most of it.
Memory is almost full. New apps will be slow.
Your PC is the bottleneck right now, not the network.
High load. The network may feel slow because of it.
wifi.drops: Your Wi-Fi dropped {v} times. See what happened just before.
{v} Wi-Fi drops today. Signal or roaming is the usual cause.
The Wi-Fi link reset {v} times today.
Wi-Fi drops today: {v}. Worth a look.
net.none: No network. Plug in a cable or pick a Wi-Fi network.
No connection at all. The internet checks are paused.
Offline. Nothing can reach the internet right now.
inet.slow: The delay starts past your router.
Your router is fast. The internet is slow.
Internet delay is {v}. The cause is past your home network.
Slow internet. Your provider's side is the likely cause.
busy: Still working. You can keep using the app.
idle: No changes in the last hour.
search.empty: Search tools by name or question.
Type a tool name, like "mtu" or "dns".
What do you want to check?
Search, or pick a question below.
freeze: Still working. The window is catching up ({v}).
Busy for {v}. Clicks will work again shortly.
Catching up after a heavy task ({v}).
speedrunner: One at a time - the last check is still running.
Give it a second to catch up.
Working on your previous click first.
back.again: Welcome back. Here is what changed.
Back. {v} changes since you last looked.
Welcome back. See what happened while you were away.
dns.slow: DNS is slow. Try a different DNS server.
speed.great: Fast and steady. Good for everything.
speed.bloat: Fast, but delay rises {v} when the line is full.
Downloads make the line laggy. This is called bufferbloat.
game.lag: Lag starts at your Wi-Fi, not the game server.
Ping spikes match your Wi-Fi signal drops.
vpn.on: Traffic is going through your VPN.
vpn.slow: Slow through the VPN, fine without it.
portal: This Wi-Fi needs a sign-in page first.
Open a browser to sign in to this network.
gw.down: No reply from your router. Restart it or check the cable.
isp.down: Your router works, but the internet doesn't.
The internet is down past your router. Check your provider's status.
mtu.small: Large packets are being dropped. Path MTU is {v}.
The path can't carry full-size packets.
port.closed: Connection failed. Something is blocking it.
cert.ok: The certificate is valid and trusted.
cert.expired: The certificate isn't valid. Browsers will warn.
mtr.lossy: Packets are lost along the way. See where it starts.
devices.found: Here are the devices your PC has talked to.
encrypt.done: Locked. Only the right person can open it.
award: You reached 500 points: the Adeebo Award.
Adeebo Award unlocked. Make your card.
late.night: It's late. Everything is still being watched.
morning: Good morning. Here is last night.
update.suspect: Things got worse after a Windows update on {v}.
A recent update may be the cause.
call.on: In a call. Jitter and loss are being tracked.
stream.on: {v} is playing smoothly. I am watching the path.
stream.none: No stream playing. I will notice when one starts.
trade.ok: Your line to the broker is fast and steady.
Broker answering normally. Nothing to wait for.
trade.slow: Slow moment to your broker. Wait before you click.
Your broker is slow right now. {v}
trade.closed: Market closed. The broker check sleeps until 9:30.
Markets are closed. Nothing is being checked.
view.switch: Switching to {v}. Your settings for it are coming back.
Changing to the {v} view. One moment.
